programme.title: Wildflowers of Texas Hill Country
programme.desc: Experience the legendary spring transformation of the American Southwest. A peaceful, high-definition escape into the heart of the Lone Star State’s most colorful season.

programme.title: High Sierra Wilderness
programme.desc:
Escape into the High Sierra wilderness, where granite peaks rise above quiet alpine lakes, evening light washes across the mountains, and steam drifts through sunlit pines beside a flowing creek.
Filmed on location by Elizabeth & Olof Carmel, High Sierra Wilderness invites you to slow down and spend time with the beauty of California's Sierra Nevada. Gentle acoustic music, spacious views, and moments of flowing water create a peaceful setting for a quiet break or an unhurried evening at home.
Let your screen become a window into the wilderness. Watch closely, settle in, and enjoy the changing light—or let the scenery bring a sense of mountain calm to your room.
Filmed and produced by Elizabeth & Olof Carmel for NatureStream.tv.
The nature footage is real and was filmed on location; no AI-generated scenery is used. Music generated with Suno AI, then selected, edited, and mixed for NatureStream.tv.
Run time: 1 hour, 44 minutes.

programme.title: Eye See You
programme.desc: Recovering from the psychological effects of witnessing a brutal crime, FBI Agent Jake Malloy (Sylvester Stallone) checks into a rehabilitation clinic for law enforcement officers in the remote wilderness of Wyoming during the dead of winter. He soon finds himself helping other patients as a serial killer begins killing them one by one.

programme.title: Crocodile
programme.desc: A group of friends goes on a boat trip - but their joyful weekend turns into horror when a giant killer crocodile, searching for its stolen eggs, picks off anyone who gets in its way.

programme.title: Maneater
programme.desc: Townspeople must venture deep into the woods to save their isolated town from an escaped Bengal tiger.

programme.title: Dominion: Prequel To The Exorcist [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Haunted by terrible acts the Nazis forced him to participate in, the disenchanted Father Lankester Merrin focuses his energies on helping with an archaeological dig in the northern part of Kenya. There, the crew uncovers a church that predates Christian missions into the area, but the discovery also causes strange events to start occurring -- including physical changes to a young, disabled boy, whom Merrin grows to suspect has been possessed by a demon.

programme.title: Black Christmas [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: As winter break begins, a group of sorority sisters, including Jess (Olivia Hussey) and the often inebriated Barb (Margot Kidder), begin to receive anonymous, lascivious phone calls. Initially, Barb eggs the caller on, but stops when he responds threateningly. Soon, Barb's friend Clare (Lynne Griffin) goes missing from the sorority house, and a local adolescent girl is murdered, leading the girls to suspect a serial killer is on the loose. But no one realizes just how near the culprit is.

programme.title: The Vault
programme.desc: Some curious students visit an abandoned school and learn its shameful history isn't fully in the past. Their trip turns into a fight for survival.

programme.title: An American Werewolf in Paris
programme.desc: A group of carousing American tourists is taking in the cultural landmarks of Paris when a chance encounter results in sightseer Andy McDermott (Tom Everett Scott) saving the life of Parisian Serafine Pigot (Julie Delpy). While on a date at a nightclub with Serafine, Andy is suddenly attacked and bitten by a werewolf. The next day he discovers that Serafine is also a lycanthrope, and that he is beginning his own grueling, hirsute transformation into one of the fanged beasts.

programme.title: The Bone Snatcher
programme.desc: When four jewel hunters are found dead in the desert with the flesh stripped from their bodies, it's up to Dr. Zack Straker to find out what's gone wrong.

programme.title: Prom Night
programme.desc: This slasher movie follows a relentless killer who is out to avenge the death of a young girl who died after being bullied and teased by four of her classmates. Now high-school students, the guilt-ridden kids have kept their involvement a secret, but when they start being murdered, one by one, it's clear that someone knows the truth. Also coping with the past are members of the dead girl's family, most notably her prom-queen sister, Kim Hammond.

programme.title: Maniac Cop 2
programme.desc: Renegade police officer Matthew Cordell (Robert Z'Dar) once roamed the streets of New York City unleashing his murderous brand of vigilante justice upon its denizens before being struck down by good cop Jack Forrest (Bruce Campbell). Now, Forrest is eager to move on from those heinous events, but he is stopped short when a familiar killing spree begins. Though thought dead and gone, Cordell is back from the grave and ready to wreak his merciless havoc once more.

programme.title: Charlie's Farm
programme.desc: Four friends go into Australia's outback to explore the site where a violent family met its end at the hands of an angry mob. Despite all warnings, they persist in their terrifying adventure.

programme.title: Maniac Cop 3: Badge of Silence
programme.desc: Cop Katie Sullivan (Gretchen Becker) shoots two crooks who are robbing a store, and though she's also wounded in the process, reporters cast her as a trigger-happy rogue. Devious police department bosses, hoping to get rid of a public relations problem, plan to kill Sullivan. But Matt Cordell (Robert Z'Dar), a dead cop who's just been resurrected, takes a liking to Sullivan and is determined to mow down her enemies before a police detective, Sean McKinney (Robert Davi), can stop him.

programme.title: Eraserhead [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Henry (John Nance) resides alone in a bleak apartment surrounded by industrial gloom. When he discovers that an earlier fling with Mary X (Charlotte Stewart) left her pregnant, he marries the expectant mother and has her move in with him. Things take a decidedly strange turn when the couple's baby turns out to be a bizarre lizard-like creature that won't stop wailing. Other characters, including a disfigured lady who lives inside a radiator, inhabit the building and add to Henry's troubles.

programme.title: Chopping Mall [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Eight teenagers are trapped after hours in a high-tech shopping mall and pursued by three murderous security robots out of control.

programme.title: Swarmed
programme.desc: The residents of a small town find themselves battling a swarm of hornets that have been sprayed by a super pesticide.

programme.title: Elvira's Movie Macabre: Manos: The Hands Of Fate

programme.title: Long Weekend
programme.desc: Peter (John Hargreaves) and Marcia (Briony Behets), a bitter married couple teetering on the edge of divorce, take a camping trip to heal the rift between them. As the weekend progresses, the selfish pair engage in reckless behavior that demonstrates an increasing disrespect for their natural surroundings. When Peter and Marcia become the targets of a series of inexplicable animal attacks, it becomes clear that an angry Mother Nature has come to exact her revenge.

Bigelow (Daniel Quinn) and his crew, who man a cargo ship. Jason is heavily drugged by the ship's doctor, Gerbac (Richard Moll), and realizes something is amiss when he comes across corpses. programme.title: Destination Wild - Wild Islands
programme.desc: Nestled alongside Canada's south west coast, Vancouver Island is home to the richest Pacific wildlife. Sea lions and killer whales are among the marine predators enjoying the abundant seafood in the surrounding waters, while black bears, marmots and beavers enjoy the rich pickings on land. But each fall, the islands inhabitants must adapt and prepare to face the coming winter. Some will leave, among them humpback whales and turkey vultures who migrate to warmer climes.

programme.title: Destination Wild - Wild Islands
programme.desc: The Falkland Islands' pristine coastlines and bountiful seas offer a lifeline and breeding centre for millions of penguins each year. Though while some find sanctuary on dry land, there's a daily battle to survive in the waters which surround these wild and rocky shores.

programme.title: Destination Wild: Wild Madagascar
programme.desc: Millions of years ago, hundreds of castaway creatures crash-landed on Madagascar's rugged shores. Isolated from the mainland, evolution went into overdrive. Of almost a quarter of a million species found on the island are unique. This myriad of bizarre life forms had a huge impact on the early human settlers - one particular group of primates shaped their culture, fuelling folklore and legend that still guides their lives today. Limited Rights Available: Worldwide, Free TV Only

programme.title: Destination Wild - Desert Lands of the Middle East
programme.desc: Turkey sits on a jumbled collection of tectonic plates, whose collisions have created a tortuous landscape. In fact 80% of Turkeys terrain is rough, broken and mountainous. Mountain ranges both collect and block weather systems, affecting the climate across the country and producing huge contrasts between and within differing habitats.

programme.title: World of the Wild
programme.desc: Prairies are a temperate grassland. Vast great plains, extremely hot in summer and cold in winter. Moderate rainfall, and a composition of grasses, herbs and shrubs, rather than trees characterise these plains. Most of North America was a vast prairie before European settlement and agriculture radically altered the environment.

programme.title: World of the Wild
programme.desc: Some of the most beautiful rainforest, jungle landscape and wildlife are in Asia. The rainforests of Asia stretch from India and Burma in the west to Malaysia and the islands of Java and Borneo in the east. The Great teak forests and Jungles in Asia have long been under threat from intensive logging and industrial farming of cash crops. Slash and burn agriculture has also taken a heavy toll on the eco-structure and environment. Bangladesh has the largest mangrove forests in the world.

programme.title: World of the Wild
programme.desc: It might look uniform from the air, as we fly over it, but the oceans are deep and varied. The underwater landscape is made up of continental shelves, volcanoes, mountains, valleys, trenches and large, flat plains similar to the landscape on land only on a much larger scale. Ocean habitats come in all forms. Under water creatures make homes wherever survival is assured.

programme.title: World of the Wild
programme.desc: Large areas of water, broken up by small islands. Massive vegetation. Swamps, wetlands, marshes, bogs and fens are found all over the world, generally in more temperate regions where there is fast vegetation growth. Many of the larger animals that inhabit swamps and wetlands have a fish-based diet. LARGE CRABS dwell in the salt-water swamps, along with SNAPPING TURTLES and even CROCODILES AND ALLIGATORS. LIZARDS AND AMPHIBIANS live in and around the water's edge.

programme.title: Destination Wild - Wild Islands
programme.desc: Nestled alongside Canada's south west coast, Vancouver Island is home to the richest Pacific wildlife. Sea lions and killer whales are among the marine predators enjoying the abundant seafood in the surrounding waters, while black bears, marmots and beavers enjoy the rich pickings on land. But each fall, the islands inhabitants must adapt and prepare to face the coming winter. Some will leave, among them humpback whales and turkey vultures who migrate to warmer climes.

programme.title: Hannah Goes to Namibia
programme.desc: Hannah runs a health check on two female cheetahs with veterinarian Maaike. She then goes into the wilderness with Naankuse founder Marlice. Together they go in search of the elephant Apollo, which was resettled in the sanctuary. The former "problem" elephant now leads a peaceful life here.

programme.title: Seasons Of The Otter
programme.desc: One of the most loves animals, famed for its playful nature and incredible underwater agility. Yet most of the life of the otter goes unseen. Following the first year in the life of a young otter family, we'll reveal the secrets of the otter's world. Otter life is often a challenge, and especially so for a young family trying to make it through winter. Two pups were born last spring, and as they approach their first birthdays the time with their mother is coming to its end.

programme.title: World's Wildest City: Anchorage
programme.desc: This unique arctic city is home over 2000 moose! And these notorious animals are running riot... Crossing busy highways, giving birth in backyards, and even doing battle, right here in suburbia! But life on the streets is fraught with danger...and in this expanding city, more highways mean more moose deaths. But the people of Anchorage are on a mission, to protect the most iconic animal in this Wild City.

programme.title: Hawaii: Paradise in the Pacific
programme.desc: In episode two we take a look at Maui and Moloka'i. In the middle of the archipelago they form the heart of Hawaii. The second largest island of Hawai'i - Maui - is a true paradise for surfers. Archie Kalepa was one of the first big wave surfers and is still chasing the thrill today. The ukulele represents the sound of the islands like no other instrument. Eric Devine has been building the plucked string instrument for 20 years. In Kula he goes in search of the perfect wood.

programme.title: Heroes of the Wild Frontiers
programme.desc: Elephant human conflict has been going on in India for decades. Only now it has increased because of the shrinking forests and the expanding human habitation. North Bengal with it's fragmented habitat of tea gardens, human habitation and paddy fields is a hot bed of conflict. We follow an elephant flying squad which is responsible for keeping the elephants away from these human dominated landscapes.

programme.title: Sexy Beasts
programme.desc: Driven by surging hormones, every creature on the planet, big or small, will do whatever it takes to find and secure a mate. For some this will take the fight of their lives, while others must preen, prance and party their way to success. From one night stands and group sex to lifelong love and unbreakable bonds, when it comes to finding a mate the animal kingdom has it all. The need to breed manifests itself in all sorts of wonderful antics, displays and behaviours.

programme.title: Wildest Survival
programme.desc: In nature, competition for territory is so extreme that some animals have resorted to living in incredible hostile conditions. From brutal cold, to extreme heat, from the ocean depths, to the driest of deserts, this episode showcases some incredible survival stories in the world's most inhospitable environments.

programme.title: Destination Wild - Desert Lands of the Middle East
programme.desc: 96% of Egypt's lands are sun-blistered desert. Rock and sand dominate this country, creating a beautiful but hostile environment. Yet it was home to the Worlds greatest ancient civilisation, which flourished for millennia and still captivates us today. These harsh lands also hold amazing animals that can survive and even thrive, able to cope with and profit from the searing temperatures and lack of moisture.

programme.title: Lion - Africa's Super Power
programme.desc: The endless plains of East Africa is a paradise for lions. The most social of all cats, lions form prides that are unlike any other animals. Together, they'll hunt, raise their young and defend their territory. With such a close family and plentiful home, the pride welcomes new babies every year. But new children introduces new dangers.

programme.title: Meet the Marsupials
programme.desc: Few countries have a more iconic representative in the animal kingdom than Australia and the marsupial. Once marsupials were found across the planet, but over time they found their way to the outback, leaving Australia as an ark carrying the future of pouch mammals. As varied as they are unusual, marsupials are a weird and wonderful mob of animals who carry their young in a pouch.

programme.title: Destination Wild - Wild Islands
programme.desc: The Falkland Islands' pristine coastlines and bountiful seas offer a lifeline and breeding centre for millions of penguins each year. Though while some find sanctuary on dry land, there's a daily battle to survive in the waters which surround these wild and rocky shores.

programme.title: Aquarium: An Aquatic Life
programme.desc: In the aftermath of Cape Towns biggest storm in 2 decades, there's a whole lot of work to be done at the Two Oceans Aquarium! The pressure builds as nine Ragged-Toothed Sharks are on their way from East London for their introduction to the new, highly anticipated predator exhibit. Join the team in one last push to complete the giant tank in time for its incoming residents and see the experience the culmination of a year of hard work coming together, at the Two Oceans Aquarium!

programme.title: Animals of the Bible
programme.desc: The bible is one of the most famous texts on earth. But it doesn't just concern humans, it also mentions animals - and some of these are probably not what you'd expect. We've all heard of the ox and the ass, the donkey that carried Mary, but did you know gazelles are mentioned in the bible? Or that great whales, cunning leopards and even the energetic hyrax feature?

programme.title: World's Wildest City: Anchorage
programme.desc: Anchorage is home to hundreds of black bears. And it's these black bears, that are patrolling the city. With their brains, their brawn and their cunning, these bears have mastered life in this urban jungle. When Spring arrives the bears hit the city as it's time to start eating. And these bears have found a source of food that is much easier to catch than a slippery salmon - it's trash. And it is everywhere. The city's bins and dumpsters have become the perfect bear restaurant.

programme.title: Costa Rica: The Rise of Nature
programme.desc: The tropical rainforests of Costa Rica provide an invaluable habitat to several emblematic species, such as jaguars, tapirs, white-lipped peccaries, spider monkeys, the very rear green macaw, amongst many others. Most of them are protected in national parks, reserves and wildlife refuges. However, the long-term survival of these ecosystems and of their biodiversity rely on the success of connecting wildlife populations throughout the country.

programme.title: Migrations - Herds on the Move
programme.desc: Whether driven by the search for food or the simple will to survive, great herd migrations are some of the most spectacular events of the natural world.

programme.title: Aging in the Wild
programme.desc: Aldabra Tortoise, Matriarch Elephants, Kittiwakes, Honey Bees, Hydra, Lions In this episode of Aging in the Wild, we explore the physiological secrets and factors that determine life expectancy in various animal species. From the seventy-year-old elephant to the quasi-immortal hydra, and the more than a hundred-year-old tortoise, we explore life expectancy, longevity and senescence. Can we distinguish between the effects of the environment and the internal adaptations that lead to longevity?

programme.title: Aging in the Wild
programme.desc: Bighorn Sheep, Elk, Male Elephants, Marmots, Baboons, Rhinos Observing two massive elk clashing their antlers is to witness a true demonstration of power. For other species, such as the European marmot, remaining in power is a matter of collaborating with family and community. Are these animals forced to give up their hard-won social status as they age? Through this lens, we take a deep and entertaining look at the challenges faced by those in power ... and what it takes to stay there.

programme.title: Nuts About Squirrels
programme.desc: Even in our most urban settings, pretty much all of us know squirrels. They can be divisive charac-ters; some people adore them, offering them food, while others see them as glorified rats. But we can all agree that these are speedy, quirky, and exceptional characters. They also go crazy for nuts. They've conquered most of the globe, from icy tundra to the hottest deserts, developing ingen-ious life skills along the way, from stashing nuts to fighting snakes.

programme.title: Lions Rule
programme.desc: The Lion, Africa's ultimate predator. An essay in power and agility, famed for the cut-throat gang and the killer instinct. Lions are known as the kings of the jungle yet their homeland is an open grassland rather than rainforest. In the African plains prey-rich real estate can be hard to come by, and lions work together to ensure no one claims their territory and usurps their crown.

programme.title: Aging in the Wild
programme.desc: Lions, Chimpanzees, Turtles, Roe Deer, Gannets Reproduction is not only a concern of the young and restless: this episode of Aging in the Wild brings a light-hearted look at the issue of sexuality and camaraderie in older animals. We illustrate, for example, the link between the age of an elephant and its reproductive success. What are the reproductive benefits of these animals as they grow older?

programme.title: Wildest Islands
programme.desc: Lying like a teardrop in the Indian Ocean, Sri Lanka is an island that defies convention. Poised just six degrees above the equator, it's less than 75,000 km sq in size. But it has enough wildlife to rival a continent, and it's all down to its complicated climate and geography.

programme.title: World's Wildest City: Anchorage
programme.desc: In Anchorage, one bird rules the roost...the Bald Eagle. Expert hunters, they are perfectly adapted to life in tough arctic conditions, but in Anchorage, the secret to their survival... is trash. Every day, hundreds of bald eagles gather at the city dump, dodging trucks, machinery, and even pyrotechnics, in search of an easy meal. But this city life also brings constant danger, for the eagles themselves, and also for the human residents.

programme.title: World of the Wild
programme.desc: Deserts - dry, arid landscapes, environments of intense sun, heat and very little rain. The desert is extreme. An extre-me climate and an extreme environment where wild life has had to adapt to survive. Many of the animals that live in deserts have adopted a nocturnal lifestyle, surfacing only at night when it is cooler.

programme.title: World of the Wild
programme.desc: The masters of the sky are the winged predators of the aerial world. Whether swooping from altitude at phenomenal speed to strike an unsuspecting target from above, flicking and darting between trees in a lethal tail chase, or ghos-ting silently through the night in pursuit of prey, they excite our admiration and inspire awe in equal measure. All are superbly adapted to hunting and masters of their position at the top of the food chain.

programme.title: World of the Wild
programme.desc: Lakes and rivers are created by streams high in the mountains. Fresh water springs, rain drawn up as moisture from the oceans, and melting snow all ebb, rush and flow down into our rivers and streams. Streams, rivers and lakes are home to countless animal species. A wide variety of species from insects, to amphibians, repti-les, fish, birds and even mammals are found in rivers, lakes and streams all around the world.

programme.title: World of the Wild
programme.desc: Wildlife that inhabits mountainous regions has be able to survive successfully at high altitudes. Any creature that lives in the mountains must also be able to cope with changing temperatures. Many species of hoofed and herbivorous mammal such as GOATS, DEER, SHEEP AND LLAMAS have adapted well to living high in the mountains and are often found grazing on ledges and on cliff faces. These herbivores in turn attract large predators such as BEARS, COUGARS AND MOUNTAIN LIONS.

programme.title: World's Wildest City: Anchorage
programme.desc: One of Alaska's most secretive and efficient predators, Lynx are usually highly elusive... but in Anchorage, houses are being built in the Lynx's territory, forcing these usually shy big cats, to find new ways to survive on the streets. As this urban jungle continues to expand into the wilderness, encounters between people and wild Lynx are on the rise. In this wild city, can people live side by side with Alaska's deadliest big cat?

programme.title: Migrations - Frequent Flyers
programme.desc: Migration is one of the most remarkable phenomena of the natural world, and perhaps the most impressive migrants of all travel on the wing.

programme.title: Owls - Masters of the Night
programme.desc: Owls are mysterious creatures, living in a twilight world that we can rarely visit. Many cultures, including the Romans, Mayans and Aztecs, saw owls as something to fear, symbols of bad luck and impending doom. In reality owls are highly resourceful birds that have carved out a niche and a unique way to live. They range in size from smaller than a pigeon to as large as an eagle. They've colonised terrains from tundra to rainforest.

programme.title: Destination Wild - Desert Lands of the Middle East
programme.desc: Turkey sits on a jumbled collection of tectonic plates, whose collisions have created a tortuous landscape. In fact 80% of Turkeys terrain is rough, broken and mountainous. Mountain ranges both collect and block weather systems, affecting the climate across the country and producing huge contrasts between and within differing habitats.

programme.title: Wild Uruguay
programme.desc: Uruguay's biodiversity is surprisingly greater than one would expect. We will find out why as we embark on a journey through its ecosystems and landscapes to discover its fauna. Today we know that Uruguay is more than just the outermost edge of the Pampas, as the country holds a range of ecosystems. Within its borders, species of the Pampas come face to face with species of the Atlantic Forest, the Misiones rainforest, and the Chaco forest, giving rise to unexpected encounters.

programme.title: The Enchanted Forest
programme.desc: To spend a day in the forest, from dawn to dusk, is to bathe in nature. There's enchantment at every turn. Throughout the day the cast of characters in the forest changes, from foraging bears to playing fox cubs, dashing hummingbirds and dancing butterflies. But it's as twilight descends, that the most enchanting side of the forest is revealed. Time to watch a firework display curtesy of fireflies. They are the real magicians of the enchanted forest.

programme.title: Cost of Progress
programme.desc: The natural world is in crisis. For years humanity has exploited the planet's resources, and the creatures that live here. Growth and innovation can be a marvelous thing, but at what cost to our one and only planet? When we continue to push ahead blindly, it's more often than not Mother Nature that pays the price. Now it is time for us to rally - to take heed and start to turn back the tide. It's time for us to recognize our part in this crisis and redress the balance of the cost of progress.

programme.title: Destination Wild - Wild Europe
programme.desc: Over the last million years, our planet suffered a series of major ice-ages. Much of the northern hemisphere was covered in ice sheets several kilometres thick and creatures had no choice but to adapt or die. Over time, temperatures rose, causing these glaciers to retreat, however, in certain parts of Europe the ice-age never left. For many creatures, the struggle to survive 'a life below zero' continues.

programme.title: World's Wildest City: Anchorage
programme.desc: This city spends most of the year encased in ice...but when summer hits, Anchorage bursts into life. Animals and plants living this far north have been forced to adapt, working faster to make the most of the short season, but these animals built to withstand Alaska's extreme winters, often struggle in Anchorage's summer heat! Temperatures can be surprisingly high, with average July highs of 26 degrees C. 300,000 people live alongside these wild animals in the ever growing city of Anchorage.

programme.title: Creepy Crawlies - Army
programme.desc: Few creatures have the complex levels of regimented society as the social insects; these creatures understand that the strength of the individual is nothing compared with the combined power of the group. Creepy crawlies can form armies to help them build elaborate homes, raise their young and hunt their prey. These incredible communities both plagues our nightmares and fuels our imaginations. Society is considered the realm of higher beings, but hidden amongst the foliage, an army is rising.

programme.title: Aging in the Wild
programme.desc: Grizzly Bears, Orcas, Elephants, Wolves, Olive Baboons In many human cultures, elders play a vital role in the well-being of communities and are responsible for passing down knowledge and culture. Is it any wonder to find that the orca, the elephant, and the wolf, have been found to transmit their respective cultures to the younger generations? Young animals learn by observing their elders.

programme.title: Our Big Blue Backyard
programme.desc: The top of New Zealand's South Island is a landscape of two halves. To the West, one of the longest natural sandbars on the planet curves protectively around Golden Bay. To the East, mountains sink into the sea, their drowned river valleys forming the Marlborough Sounds. Turbulent currents connect them, both treacherous and full of riches.
programme.sub-title: Top of the South/ Te Tau Ihu

programme.title: Urban Warrirors
programme.desc: As human populations grow, so does our footprint, and more of the natural world is gradually paved over, displacing animals from their natural homes. It presents a staggering number of difficulties for those creatures that find themselves cut off from their natural habitat, but there is a growing band of urban warriors stepping up to the challenge. City life for some means living on the breadline, while others discover a land of opportunity - a new concrete frontier.

programme.title: Our Big Blue Backyard
programme.desc: On the doorstep of one of the country's biggest cities, Muaūpoko /Otago Peninsula provides a breeding refuge for birds and marine mammals. Northern royal albatrosses return here every year to raise their chicks at the world's only mainland colony. On sheltered beaches around the Peninsula, once hunted from these shores, New Zealand sea lions are returning to form a breeding colony after an absence of centuries.

programme.title: Mother's Day
programme.desc: Being a wild mum is one of the toughest jobs on earth. From the second a mother gives birth, everything changes. No longer footloose and fancy free, they find themselves completely responsible for tiny, delicate little lives - lives that would be helpless without them. For some, being a mother comes naturally, whilst for others it will take a little practoce. But while the responsibility is immense, being a mum is also incredible.

programme.title: Easter The Start of Something Big
programme.desc: Easter, not just a chocolate feast loved by children. One of the biggest events in the religious calendar, celebrated by millions and steeped in customs and traditions. And for all its different meanings there are some key characters we associate with the holiday: chicks, bunnies and lambs have become integral to our celebrations. How have these animals become a part of Easter tradition? There are many twists and turns in the story, but without a doubt this is the start of something big!

programme.title: Secret Life of Baby Owls
programme.desc: Owls - with their huge eyes, flat faces and distinctive hoot - they are truly iconic!creatures. But how much do we really know about these mysterious nocturnal birds? We're about to find out as we follow the fate of new born baby owls as they grow up and learn to fly.

programme.title: Hidden Spain
programme.desc: Spain is found at the crossroads between the Mediterranean and the Atlantic, resulting in diverse landscapes, ancient cultures and magnificent wildlife.

programme.title: Hawaii: Paradise in the Pacific
programme.desc: In epsiode one we take a look at Kaua'i - the oldest island in the archipelago. Kaua'i's isolation for thousands of years led to an increased rate of evolution. In a relatively short time, new species are formed here, many animals and plants can only be found here. But they are in danger. On the shield volcano Waiʻaleʻale - the rainiest place on earth, scientists like Lukas Behnke are fighting for the preservation of endangered native animals and plants.

programme.desc: Help me, Sammy!' Our hero Sammy is here to rescue friends in need! Explore safety tips through lively rhymes and engaging games. Let's get started!

programme.title: Chinese Hercules
programme.desc: Chan is a fighter haunted by his past. He takes a job as a dock worker in a small village. The dock owner steadily abuses his workers. The workers struggle to fight back, but only Chan is strong enough to beat the company bosses and their henchmen.

programme.title: Battles with Red Boy
programme.desc: Shaw Brothers starlet Tien stars as the mythical deity Red Boy. He is sent by the gods to do battle with the monkey King who is up to more magical mischief than is good for him.

programme.title: Phoenix the Ninja
programme.desc: An orphan girl becomes a martial arts expert to revenge her murdered family, and discovers that the evil monk behind the play has turned her loved ones against her.

programme.title: Mantis Under Falcon Claws
programme.desc: A silk dealer and a princess are traveling in the China country, when they are attacked by a group of Falcon bandits. The bandits kidnap the princess and steal the silk. The princess's father makes an effort to free his daughter, but fails, and the bandits demand a ransom. Meanwhile, the silk dealer goes to a Shaolin temple, and trains to learn Mantis kung fu.

programme.title: A Fighters Journey
programme.desc: By 2008 Jonathan Brookins was already a seasoned fighter, having faced UFC champion Jose Aldo. His good looks, golden dreadlocks and sharp intellect, made him a fight fan favorite. But when Brookins was crowned the Ultimate Fighter after winning the 12th Season UFC Finale, what is fans didn't know is that he was facing a much tougher opponent outside the cage... himself. Drugs and alcohol together with an eating disorder had taken it's toll on Brookins.

programme.title: Martial Arts History Museum Biography: Leo Fong
programme.desc: Filmmaker, martial arts legend, Leo Fong was one of the early pioneers of martial arts in America. From judo to jiu jitsu to choy lay fut to wing chun to Shaolin styles, Fong helped open the doors of the arts to a new generation. A former champion boxer, he was the first to introduce unique forms for weight training to the martial arts world.

programme.title: Mean Streets of Kung Fu
programme.desc: When challenged by a local gangster, a top martial arts student (Barry Chan) proves his skill and determination and defeats the thug. Now it's open warfare and fierce battles between the forces of good and evil.

programme.title: Fearless Dragons aka Two on the Road
programme.desc: A shipment of gold is stolen, and two transients are blamed. This sets the stage for a major action adventure, with some of the best names in the genre. Kung Fu superstars Philip Ko and Leung Kar Yan play the leads. They face off against Wang Lung Wei, in what many consider one of the best end fights in history. Years later, all involved said this film took something out of them! A Times Square favorite: true action.

programme.title: Dance of Death
programme.desc: Kung fu girl, Angela Mao tricks two equally matched kung fu masters who duel every five years into teaching her both of their styles so she can take revenge against a vicious gang that killed her friends. The teachers stand by during her fights and count the number of moves that she uses to defeat her enemies so they can prove which of them is superior. This is one of the best choreographed Angela Mao movies, and is recommended for viewing by all Angela Mao fans.

programme.title: One Shot, One Life
programme.desc: In traditional martial arts, mastery of the art is not acquired through technical skill alone. In following 'The Way' one must look beyond technique to become a true master. In Japanese archery or Kyudo, hitting the target by itself is not enough. To shoot correctly we are told to "Shoot from the Heart". As Takeuchi sensei says "As a national team member I had to hit the target no matter what. Eventually all that technique became obsolete in exchange to express myself through the bow".

programme.title: Art of the Japanese Sword
programme.desc: The Japanese sword ... prized as much for its exceptional beauty as for its deadly cutting ability. It has endured for a thousand years as the pinnacle of Japanese culture. Now you can enter a world rarely seen by outsiders. To experience the true story of the Art of the Samurai Sword. A story told in the swordsmiths own words that separate the myth from the fact. Follow the swordsmiths dream of creating a masterpiece.

programme.title: Shaolin Chastity Kung Fu
programme.desc: After the massacre of a small village, a group of survivors led by Ah Tien are trained by a mysterious monk. They train in the arcane secrets of Tong Zi Kung. Soon they decide to avenge their loved ones against the Nine Devil Gang.

programme.title: Ninja Champion
programme.desc: Two Interpol agents, Donald and George, are on the trail to smash up an international diamond smuggling gang. But the leader of the gang is determined to destroy them at all cost and evokes his evil ninja powers to corrupt and destroy all those who stand in his way.

programme.title: Eagle vs Silver Fox
programme.desc: After the downfall of the Manchu Dynasty, the surviving officials plan to restore order across China. One of these men, Silver Fox, hires the best fighters in the country to assassinate those who were responsible for the revolution and destroy all martial arts schools. To combat this menace the various schools band together and nominate Chow Fung, master of the Eagle form, to face the might of the Silver Fox in a one-on-one bone-breaking showdown.

programme.title: Masters of Heaven and Earth
programme.desc: Experience a Tai Chi Chuan class with Master Cui Zhongsan in Beijing and listen to him explain the history and philosopy of Yang style and how and why it developed as a seperate style from Chen Tai Chi. Visit the small remote Chen village, the birthplace of Tai Chi and learn the history of Tai Chi with the Chen family. It was here that Yang style was born through Chen student Yang Luchan.

programme.title: Champ Against Champ
programme.desc: Tinfeng, the leader of the Devil's Gate bandit gang in the North has ambitions to rule the entire country, but meets fierce resistance from Pak and his armies. When Pak is attacked by Tinfeng's Powerful Lions, his son in laws, only hope for justice is crippled. Dragon must learn the 18 kicks technique to overcome a multitude of traps and challenges before he can face Tinfeng for the final showdown.

programme.title: Iron Dragon Strikes Back
programme.desc: Bruce Li discovers a hidden stash of gold while scuba diving, he and his friends divide it up between them. The gang who stole the gold track Bruce and his friends down one by one slowly getting back what they believe to be their property.

programme.title: Secret Rivals 2
programme.desc: This direct sequel is better than the original, minus Wang Tao. In this flick, Chin Hu (Gold Fox) (Hwang Jang Lee), learns of his brother's death and then swears revenge. Chin Hu cannot take his revenge against Shen Yi Wei due to the Government deploying him to a faraway place in China, so he decides to knock off his kid brother, Shen Ying Wu. Hsiao Yi Fei (John Liu) returns in time to help Ying Wu fend off Chin Hu and his crew's attempts to eliminate Ying Wu.

programme.title: Shaolin vs Lama
programme.desc: Skilled fighter Sung Li Ting is looking for a Kung Fu master who can beat him in battle and teach him new techniques. Shaolin monk Shao Si Yer introduces Sung Li to the Shaolin teachings, but Sung Li is not allowed to enter the school until the return of a Lama Monk, who stole a secret scroll containing every known fighting style from the monastery 12 years earlier.

programme.title: Dragon's Snake Fist
programme.desc: Two competing kung fu schools, the Dragon Fist and the Jeet-Kune, battle it out for supremacy, with technique after technique being employed to get the upper hand. Will Snake Fist Lee vanquish the deadly Golden Needles of his arch-enemy Ho and bring honor to his clan? A duel to the death is the only inevitability!

programme.title: Rivals of the Silver Fox
programme.desc: Chao-Kien (Casanova Wong), The Invisible Thief, in a desperate quest to avenge his wife's death steals a sword from the master of Devil Valley Lodge . To survive the final life-and-death battle for justice, he trains hard under the instruction of an old kung fu master. He must pass the test of the deadly gates of gold; wood, water, fire and earth.

programme.title: Green Jade Statuette
programme.desc: A band of criminal's returns to a vice-filled village one year after their theft of a valuable family artifact, along with a talented fighter hired to recover the relic. Top-notch old-school shapes from the team that brought you "Eagles Claw".

programme.title: Ninja Fist of Fire
programme.desc: Martial arts action with a Ninja prince trying to overcome the odds and gain his rightful place on the throne.

programme.title: 52 Masters
programme.desc: Will is thrown by Brazilian Jiu-Jutsu fighter Efrain Sevilla.
programme.sub-title: 52 Masters: BJJ WRESTLING with Efrain Sevilla

programme.title: Return of Fist of Fury
programme.desc: Pai Wu Chin (Bruce Pak) is a stranger in town who is on a mission to find out the whereabouts of his missing brother (Bruce Le), who rumor has it, was murdered by the chief inspector of police. Pei Chiu Ting is the brother of the ex-chief inspector and is now the head samurai who wants Pai Wu killed on site. Non-stop action follows when Pai Wu meets Po Zu Pai, who together faces their common enemy and fights the samurai clan.

programme.title: The Iron Profligate
programme.desc: A detective and self-confessed profligate and martial artists of the highest caliber team up to smash an illegal gambling house and drug smuggling outfit.

programme.title: Ninja over the Great Wall
programme.desc: Ninja over the Great Wall takes place in the early nineteen-thirties when China was occupied by the Japanese imperial forces. Wa Chi Keung is a peasant who escaped the mass murder of his village by the Japanese. He joins his master in Beijing shortly before the old man's assassination by ninjas. What follows is a one man war on the Ninjas and Japan top bushido experts.

programme.title: Method Man aka Fearless Young Boxer
programme.desc: After his father is murdered by a cold blooded killer, Xiao Lung joins an acrobat troupe in order to further his skills in martial arts. One day while performing he sees the killer, who is after other members of the troupe, like Xiao Lung's father they are-break away members of a large and powerful gang. Xiao Lung is no match for the killer, but after all the other members of the troupe are wiped out, it's up to Xiao Lung to get revenge on them all.

programme.title: Martial Arts History Museum Biography: Art Camacho
programme.desc: Art Camacho is one of the premiere filmmakers in the martial arts industry. From a stuntman to a fight choreographer to the director's chair, Camacho's career includes over 22 film projects wit 36 credits in producing, acting and stuntwork. An award-winning film director, Camacho provides a candid interview about growing up Hispanic, the failures he faced, the influence Bruce Lee played on his life and what it took to break into the film industry.

programme.title: Lethal Three - Sanbiki ga Kiru
programme.desc: A case of mistaken identity leads to Tono-sama being treated like a VIP and the rest of everyone being scorned.
programme.sub-title: Lethal Three - Sanbiki ga Kiru: Episode 11

programme.title: Deadly Silver Spear
programme.desc: A Wang Yu as Silver Spear meets the Flying Guillotine. He is hired by a noblewoman to do away with three top-class Kung Fu masters, but news reaches the ears of the white haired man, who deploys his own killers to deal with "Silver Spear". Unperturbed, "Silver Spear" continues on his mission to take down all three master fighters!

programme.title: Shogun's Samurai
programme.desc: The shogun falls in love with a mysterious woman who Jubei suspects to be a spy. With the Shogun's life on the line, Jubei and his ura-yagyus must hurry to find the truth before its too late.

programme.title: Cheyenne
programme.desc: Cheyenne leads a group of stockade prisoners on a mission to rescue two girls kidnapped by the Kiowa five years ago. Along the journey, he begins to wonder if the girls really do want to be returned to their father after all.

programme.title: Maverick
programme.desc: A flood traps Bret and Bart Maverick in a cabin with Dandy Jim Buckley, who asks why they can't go back to Texas. They reveal they were framed for murder. Later, Bart searches for the "Tall Man" who can exonerate them.

programme.title: An Eye for an Eye
programme.desc: A retired bounty hunter with enemies returns home to find his ranch ablaze and his family dead. Now, he is determined to even the score when he befriends a young gunman and the two look to bring the killers to justice.

programme.title: Prairie Fever
programme.desc: Out West, an ex-lawman gets a ticket out of jail, and a fistful of cash to deliver disturbed and rejected mail-order brides to a train going East. A spunky and troubled lady gambler on the run comes to the man's aid, but trouble follows them all.

programme.title: The Rifleman
programme.desc: A troubled 18-year-old named Johnny Clover ransacks the North Fork Schoolhouse, stealing art supplies. Lucas later tries to help Johnny, but he lives with a controlling uncle who proves to be difficult to deal with.

programme.title: Maverick
programme.desc: Bret and Bart Maverick ride into a small Arizona town and are quickly mistaken for Doc Holliday and Wyatt Earp. The sheriff needs their help as the Mundy gang is planning a bank robbery. The brothers go along with the deception and stop the outlaws.

programme.title: Cheyenne
programme.desc: During his travels, Cheyenne arrives in a small town and quickly befriends the local sheriff. However, he soon finds himself caught up with a pretty young woman, as well as a stash of stolen money, which jeopardizes his new friendship.

programme.title: Cheyenne
programme.desc: A wealthy rancher hires Cheyenne as a ranch foreman. Shortly after he begins his duties, his friend falls in love with the boss' beautiful daughter. However, the rancher has other plans, as his sights are set on Cheyenne to become his new son-in-law.

programme.title: The Rifleman
programme.desc: A brutal snowstorm makes the roads impassable and forces a stagecoach to stop at the McCain Ranch. Lucas gives the passengers shelter, but little does he know a dance hall girl, a drunk, and a famous gunslinger are his guests.

programme.title: The Rifleman
programme.desc: Brothers Charv and Kelly Banner play a joke on Lucas that soon gets out of hand when they contact a St. Louis marriage bureau to send a possible bride for Lucas. Mary Woodson arrives in North Fork ready for marriage, but Lucas wants no part of it.

programme.title: The Ranger, the Cook and a Hole in the Sky
programme.desc: In 1919, a legendary senior forest ranger leads an elite crew of very rugged men while teaching a young intern about the perils of forest fires, wild animals, and the Montana wilderness.

programme.title: Cheyenne

programme.title: An Eye for an Eye
programme.desc: A retired bounty hunter with enemies returns home to find his ranch ablaze and his family dead. Now, he is determined to even the score when he befriends a young gunman and the two look to bring the killers to justice.

programme.title: Maverick
programme.desc: Bret Maverick is blackmailed into becoming sheriff of the wild town of Duck 'n' Shoot. He deals with outlaws and somehow tames the town. However, after getting involved with a crooked woman, Bret ends up in his own jail, forcing Bart to bail him out.
programme.sub-title: Maverick - The Sheriff of Duck 'n' Shoot

programme.title: Cheyenne
programme.desc: A woman who endures many hardships but maintains her strong faith in God impresses Cheyenne. With her husband wounded and unable to work, Cheyenne, and Billy the Kid, join forces to help her drive her herd of cattle 50 miles.

programme.title: The Rifleman
programme.desc: Micah's friends, Jake Owens, and his pretty wife, Fay, are Lucas' new neighbors. Jake is wildly jealous of Fay and wrongly imagines Lucas and Fay are having a romance. Jake soon threatens to kill Lucas, which almost leads to his own death instead.

programme.title: The Rifleman
programme.desc: As soon as aging Leota Carraway and her teenage son, Hab, arrive in North Fork, they see Marshal Micah Torrance, who she takes as her long-lost husband who abandoned her 16 years ago. Lucas investigates and finds a gambler who looks just like Micah.

programme.title: Eagle's Wing
programme.desc: A cunning fur trapper steals a prized white mustang, igniting a fierce pursuit by the Kiowa warrior who claims the horse as his own. As the trapper flees across the plains, the warrior's resolve is tested in his quest to reclaim the horse.

programme.title: Cheyenne
programme.desc: Amarillo Ames asks Cheyenne to help drive a herd of cattle to Dodge City and take over the mission if he perishes. When Ames dies, Cheyenne must forcefully take on the Laverson brothers, who do not want him in charge of the drive.

programme.title: Maverick
programme.desc: After Stephanie Malone robs Bart Maverick at gunpoint to pay her father's gambling debt, Bart follows her from town posing as a repentant gambler hoping to win back his money. To do so, he must navigate the people and laws of the different towns.
programme.sub-title: Maverick - A Tale of Three Cities

programme.title: Maverick
programme.desc: Bret Maverick is on jury duty for the murder trial of a young man accused of killing a rancher. He is the only juror who believes the defendant is not guilty. He sways the other eleven jurors on a bet by performing an elaborate poker card trick.

programme.title: Cheyenne
programme.desc: In repayment for a debt owed him, Cheyenne receives the deed worth $3000 to a livery stable in Gunsight. However, Cheyenne discovers the truth when he learns of weekly payment to the Gerrard Gang is part of the deal.

programme.title: Cheyenne
programme.desc: Cheyenne rescues a baby from the wreckage of a stagecoach after an attack causes it to crash. He learns that the infant could be in danger when he discovers that the baby is now the heir to a large parcel of land after the murder of the landowner.

programme.title: Chaos
programme.desc: A veteran detective is teamed with a rookie cop when they are sent to negotiate with a bunch of criminals holding a bank hostage. It transpires that a master thief has planted a computer virus that will drain funds from the bank's accounts. The detective faces a race against time to catch the thief and stop the randomly evolving computer virus, which models its behavior on the bewildering principles of chaos theory.

programme.title: Zulu
programme.desc: Three South African cops (Orlando Bloom, Forest Whitaker, Conrad Kemp) investigate the drug-related murder of a young woman.

programme.title: Original Gangstas
programme.desc: Successful Los Angeles football coach John Bookman returns home to Gary, IN, when his father is murdered. Discovering the town overrun with violent street gangs, John is even more horrified to learn his father was shot by a member of the Rebels, a gang John himself helped form in his youth. John teams up with Jake and Laurie, the parents of a boy who was also killed by a Rebel, to organize their neighborhood against gang violence.

programme.title: Soda Cracker
programme.desc: A Chicago police officer practices his own brand of justice to take down the killers who murdered his partner.

programme.title: Holiday Heart
programme.desc: After losing his police officer lover, Christian drag queen Holiday Heart (Ving Rhames) meets 12-year-old Niki (Jessika Quynn Reynolds) and her drug-addicted mother, Wanda (Alfre Woodard). Heart finds relief from heartache and a renewed sense of purpose when he steps in as a father figure to Niki and welcomes the two women into his life. But when Wanda becomes romantically involved with her drug dealer, Silas, it may endanger Niki and threaten to destroy the makeshift family.

programme.title: Addicted
programme.desc: Successful businesswoman Zoe Reynard (Sharon Leal) seems to have a charmed life. She has a wonderful, loving husband (Boris Kodjoe), two beautiful children and a thriving career. However, as perfect as her life might look to other people, Zoe is secretly tormented by nymphomania. Her need for constant sexual gratification leads her into a secretive existence -- one that, ultimately, may put her family, career and life on the line. Based on a novel by Zane.

programme.title: Reasonable Doubt
programme.desc: A prosecutor (Dominic Cooper) commits a fatal hit-and-run, then manipulates the case so that the man who was arrested for the crime is acquitted. After the trial, he discovers that his actions have freed a guilty man.

programme.title: The Best of Enemies
programme.desc: The true story of the unlikely relationship between Ann Atwater, an outspoken civil rights activist, and C.P. Ellis, a local Ku Klux Klan leader. During the racially charged summer of 1971, Atwater and Ellis come together to co-chair a community summit on the desegregation of schools in Durham, N.C. The ensuing debate and battle soon lead to surprising revelations that change both of their lives forever.

programme.title: In the Heat of the Night: Give Me Your Life
programme.desc: As Gillespie (Carroll O'Connor) and Harriet prepare to leave for their honeymoon, Forbes (Carl Weathers) clashes with a charismatic cult leader (Peter Fonda) who has arrived in Sparta.

programme.title: In the Heat of the Night: A Matter of Justice
programme.desc: The trail of a serial killer leads the sheriff (Carroll O'Connor) and police chief (Carl Weathers) to a prominent citizen in Sparta, Miss.

programme.title: Monster's Ball
programme.desc: Hank, an embittered racist prison guard working on death row, begins an unlikely, emotionally charged sexual relationship with Leticia, a Black woman and wife of a man sentenced to death. The affair begins just after Hank oversees the capital punishment of Leticia's husband.

programme.title: Shottas
programme.desc: Deported from the United States, two drug dealers (Ky-Mani Marley, Spragga Benz) travel to Miami and continue their violent ways.

programme.title: The Island
programme.desc: When his brother is killed, LAPD officer Mark leaves the city to return to the island he grew up on. Seeking answers and vengeance, he soon finds himself in a bloody battle with the corrupt tycoon who's taken over the island paradise.

programme.title: Lazarus
programme.desc: Brought back from the dead, a vigilante uses his newfound superpowers to battle an evil organization.

programme.title: Cops and Robbers
programme.desc: A hostage negotiator plays a dangerous game of cat and mouse with a cornered bank robber who is hell-bent on getting out of the bank and humiliating the negotiator in the process.

programme.title: Mad Money
programme.desc: After her husband loses his job, upper-crust housewife Bridget Cardigan (Diane Keaton) is forced to take a job as a janitor at the Federal Reserve Bank of Kansas City, Mo. Spotting a weakness in the bank's security system, Bridget convinces her two new friends Nina (Queen Latifah) and Jackie (Katie Holmes) to help her steal a fortune in worn-out bills that have been earmarked for destruction.

programme.title: Sprung
programme.desc: Clyde (Joe Torry) and his photographer pal Montel (Rusty Cundieff) meet gold digger Adina (Paula Jai Parker) and her friend Brandy (Tisha Campbell), a law student, at a party. While Clyde convinces Adina that he's wealthy, Montel and Brandy pair off and get along well. Adina is furious when she learns Clyde has misled her, but when they learn their friends plan to marry -- which would force the two enemies to spend time together -- they put their differences aside to thwart the marriage.

programme.title: A New Kind of Woman
programme.desc: Interpersonal relationships are quickly pushed to the edge as a pompous husband, Brian, and his battered wife, Latavia, hold a brunch with unexpected consequences. When their invited guests, Todd and Glenda arrive, inhibitions are lowered, and lingering hostile and dark secrets are revealed. Sex, relationships, class, and revenge are explored over a bit too much wine.

programme.title: House Arrest
programme.desc: DeAndre (Jayceon Taylor) becomes involved in a computer chip scheme, and his girlfriend is charged with the crime and placed under house arrest.

programme.title: American Violet
programme.desc: After an overzealous district attorney's drug bust lands her in jail, single mother Dee Roberts (Nicole Beharie) must face an agonizing choice: Plead guilty and go home a convicted felon, or fight the charges and risk a lengthy prison sentence. Despite her mother's (Alfre Woodard) advice and risking everything, innocent Dee chooses to fight the Texas criminal justice system, joined by an ACLU attorney (Tim Blake Nelson) and a former narcotics cop (Will Patton).

programme.title: Crash
programme.desc: Writer-director Paul Haggis interweaves several connected stories about race, class, family and gender in Los Angeles in the aftermath of 9/11. Characters include a district attorney (Brendan Fraser) and his casually prejudiced wife (Sandra Bullock), dating police detectives Graham (Don Cheadle) and Ria (Jennifer Esposito), a victimized Middle Eastern store owner and a wealthy African-American couple (Terrence Dashon Howard, Thandie Newton) humiliated by a racist traffic cop (Matt Dillon).

programme.title: Spirit Lost
programme.desc: The seductive ghost of a sea captain's abandoned lover haunts the beachside home of an artist and his wife.

programme.title: Night Train
programme.desc: Greed and betrayal ensnares three people (Danny Glover, Steve Zahn, Leelee Sobieski) when they find a stash of diamonds aboard a train.

programme.title: Falcon Rising
programme.desc: A former Marine (Michael Jai White) travels to Brazil to hunt down the brutal Japanese mobsters who attacked his sister and left her for dead.

programme.desc: Gualberto "Weber" Elizondo surprised his family when his grilling hobby turned him into a local celebrity and internet sensation. Meanwhile, chef Chuy Villareal of Cara De Vaca wants the world to know that the north of Mexico isn't just carne asada.

programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table
programme.desc: No trip to Yucatán is complete without seeing a beautiful cenote, natural freshwater pools in caves. To learn more about Mayan communities, Pati visits Cenote Xocempich with lawyer Zoila Cen, who has dedicated her career to helping Mayan people.

programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table
programme.desc: Pati is in one of Mexico's most popular beach destinations - Puerto Vallarta. She gets an insider's tour of the best street food from one of the town's most acclaimed chefs, Thierry Boulet.

programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table
programme.desc: Pati visits the birthplace of Mexico's most famous spirit, the town of Tequila. Back home Pati makes a brunch of corn tortilla egg nests with salsa verde con chile de árbol and traditional arroz rojo.

programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table
programme.desc: In Tekit, the capital of the Guayabera, Pati encounters a tale of sons going against their father's wishes to follow their own path. Pati meets a farmer's son who went against his father to build a family business making the iconic Guayabera shirts.

programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table
programme.desc: Pati experiences the Escaramuza — An all-female horse riding and skills competition. In the kitchen, Pati makes Jalisco-style birria and her friend, pastry chef and cookbook author Fany Gerson, joins her to make gelatinas for dessert.

programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table
programme.desc: An ingredient Pati constantly uses is salt and Yucatán has one of the unique salts. The Las Coloradas salt, which means blush red, gets its distinctive color from red algae. Felipe Perez takes Pati to the pink lakes where the salt is produced.

programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table
programme.desc: Pati arrives in Motul, a town in the history books for Yucatán's once thriving henequén industry and for the egg dish Huevos Motuleños. Pati meets Doña Evelia, who put Motul back on the map with her world-famous recipe.

programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table
programme.desc: Pati visits Chef Wilson Alonzo in his hometown of Halachó to prepare a traditional Cochinita Pibil in an underground pit. Pati helps Wilson prepare the achiote marinade, along with his grandmother who taught him traditional cooking.
programme.sub-title: An Underground Pit of Cochinita Pibil

programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table
programme.desc: Pati meets the young chefs behind one of Guadalajara's most exciting restaurants, Xokol. Back home, Pati invites her friend Francisco Migoya over to make conchas to go with pellizcadas with chicharrón in salsa verde.

programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table
programme.desc: In Yaxunah, Pati discovers Yucatán's league of their own. She joins the Amazonas, a softball team of indigenous women, for their morning practice. As they built a name for themselves, they overcame the mindset that women belong in the kitchen.
programme.sub-title: A Mayan League of their Own

programme.title: Jamie Oliver Cooks Italy

programme.title: Jamie Oliver Cooks Italy

programme.sub-title: Jarred Pepper Pasta and Sheet Pan Brisket

programme.sub-title: Smash Burger and Creamy Chicken with Mushrooms

programme.title: Masters of the Universe
programme.desc: When the evil Skeletor (Frank Langella) finds a mysterious power called the Cosmic Key, he becomes nearly invincible. However, courageous warrior He-Man (Dolph Lundgren) locates inventor Gwildor (Billy Barty), who created the Key and has another version of it. During a battle, one of the Keys is transported to Earth, where it is found by teenagers Julie (Courteney Cox) and Kevin (Robert Duncan McNeill). Now both He-Man and Skeletor's forces arrive on Earth searching for the potent weapon.

programme.title: The Lazarus Effect
programme.desc: Medical researcher Frank (Mark Duplass), his fiancée Zoe (Olivia Wilde) and their team have achieved the impossible: they have found a way to revive the dead. After a successful, but unsanctioned, experiment on a lifeless animal, they are ready to make their work public. However, when their dean learns what they've done, he shuts them down. Zoe is killed during an attempt to recreate the experiment, leading Frank to test the process on her. Zoe is revived -- but something evil is within her.

programme.title: Night of the Comet
